bullets.text: Minister Dr. R. Kumar participated in the 18th India Game Developer Conference held at the Chennai Trade Centre.
A 21-year-old man named Maitreyan was hacked to death by a gang in broad daylight in Adyar, prompting outrage and arrests.
Bharathiyar Nagar residents in Thiruvallur expressed severe distress as high tidal waves and rainwaters flooded their homes.
Students staged a sudden road roko near Tiruttani demanding the repair of a damaged village mud road.
Highways authorities filled potholes on the Tambaram-Velachery Road using resin binder following public complaints.
Dumping of construction debris meant to encroach on government land near the Velachery-Taramani railway road is being cleared.
Heavy rains are predicted for Tiruvallur district around November 3 due to a new low-pressure area.
Police arrested a lorry driver and seized sand being illegally smuggled from Nagari in Andhra Pradesh through the Ponpadi checkpoint.
Relatives faced a three-hour delay at the Thirumazhisai electric crematorium due to generator issues during a cremation.
L&T's Vyoma.AI broke ground on a 52 MW AI-ready data centre in Chennai to support expanding AI workloads.
OneQode secured 14 MW of Chennai AI capacity through an agreement with AdaniConneX.
Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation issued a tender to adopt artificial intelligence technology.
DMK leader M.K. Stalin condemned the daylight murder of a youth in Chennai and criticized the current administration over public safety.
MP Kanimozhi criticized the state government for failing to control the prices of Aavin products.
